package example.bankwealth.v2.domain.values

import net.imadz.common.CommonTypes.iMadzError

sealed abstract case class NavDecimal private (value: BigDecimal) {
  def isPositive: Boolean = value > 0
  def compareSameUnit(other: NavDecimal): Either[iMadzError, Int] =
    Right(value.compare(other.value))
  def plus(other: NavDecimal): Either[iMadzError, NavDecimal] =
    for {
      lhs <- NavDecimal.checkedAmount(value)
      rhs <- NavDecimal.checkedAmount(other.value)
      result <- NavDecimal.checkedAmount(lhs + rhs)
    } yield new NavDecimal(result) {}
  def minus(other: NavDecimal): Either[iMadzError, NavDecimal] =
    for {
      lhs <- NavDecimal.checkedAmount(value)
      rhs <- NavDecimal.checkedAmount(other.value)
      result <- NavDecimal.checkedAmount(lhs - rhs)
    } yield new NavDecimal(result) {}
}
object NavDecimal {
  val Zero: NavDecimal = new NavDecimal(BigDecimal("0.0000")) {}
  def create(value: BigDecimal): Either[iMadzError, NavDecimal] =
    checkedAmount(value).map(a => new NavDecimal(a) {})
  def checkedAmount(value: BigDecimal): Either[iMadzError, BigDecimal] = {
    val stripped = value.bigDecimal.stripTrailingZeros()
    if (stripped.scale() > 4) Left(iMadzError("EXACT_SCALE_EXCEEDED", "exact scale exceeded"))
    else {
      val scaled = stripped.setScale(4, java.math.RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY)
      if (scaled.precision() > 38) Left(iMadzError("EXACT_PRECISION_EXCEEDED", "exact precision exceeded"))
      else Right(new scala.math.BigDecimal(scaled, java.math.MathContext.UNLIMITED))
    }
  }
}
